question: The average age of 30 men is 25 years. 5 new men of an average age of 30 years joined them. Find the average age of all the men put together.
solution:
**Given:**

The average age of 30 men = 25 years

The number of new men = 5

The average age of new men = 30 years

**Concept:** 

Average = Sum of Observations/Number of Observations

**Solution:**

⇒ Total age of 30 men = 30 × 25 years = 750 years

⇒ Total age of 5 new men = 5 × 30 years = 150 years

⇒ Total age of all men = Total age of 30 men + Total age of 5 men = 750 + 150 = 900 years

⇒ Total number of men = 30 + 5 = 35

⇒ Average age of all men = Total age of all men/Total number of men

⇒ 900/35 = 180/7 = 25(5)/(7)​ years

**Therefore, the average age of all men is 25(5)/(7)​ years.**

3c
